hooks.command: if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/guardrail_hook.py" post-edit

case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_MAP_GATE:-}" in true|True|TRUE|1) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/map_gate.py"

if python3 -c 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/guardrail_hook.py" is-git-commit || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -f maps/project-map.md ] || exit 0; S=scripts; [ -f "$S/init_mapping.py" ] || S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts"; "$PY" "$S/check_dependency_budget.py" --no-color >&2 || exit 2; "$PY" "$S/init_mapping.py" --check --no-color >&2 || exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Commit gate: dependency budget and map freshness...
